# Venting

Venting is a private, on-device emotional wellness app — a tiny safe room in your phone.

## What it is
A calming space where users express feelings through voice recordings, notes, doodling, stickers, calming games, a customizable diary, and a private calendar. Everything stays on the user's device. No accounts, no uploads, no social features.

## Key pages
- Landing: https://venting.app/
- Login: https://venting.app/login

## Values
- 100% private — all data is stored locally on the user's device
- No tracking, no analytics, no cloud sync
- Soft, cozy, calming design in pastel Old Lace and Wisteria Blue
- Free to use with no ads
